## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes for users or operators.

## Verification

List commands run and relevant results. Include screenshots for UI changes or sanitized SMTP evidence for protocol changes.

- [ ] Typecheck, lint, tests, and build pass
- [ ] Changed behavior has appropriate regression coverage
- [ ] Documentation and environment examples reflect the change
- [ ] No secrets, real message content, or personal mailbox data are included
- [ ] Security and compatibility implications have been explained
